NewsArticle.Title: Traps Restored
NewsArticle.Content: It turns out that there was another old server bug that had caused the damage of traps to be doubled. This is something that has been in existance though since the creation of the traps. So, we have reprogrammed the traps so that the damage will return to the way it was before. We apologize for the inconvience. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
